name: MissionRecordGet
description: mission table lookup: idx = MissionIdToIndex(dm[4], id); returns *dm + 8 + idx*0x198 (table = LFM archive_03 52/BD29..., 130 records); 124 callers

name: MissionIdToIndex
description: open-addressing u32->index map at [[0x45B9E30]]+0x20; -1 if absent

name: MissionSelectListBuild
description: walks all 0x198-B mission records; keeps flags40&(1|0x40|0x4000)==0, kind(+0x15a) 0 main/1 sub, era-progress>=+0x17e, MissionUnlockedGet, era byte +0x160 == menu era; emits 0x20-B rows (cat 2 main / 3 sub, status 4 = cleared); callers 0x1E84184, 0x9C4E48

name: MissionClearDbFlag29Get
signature: bool MissionClearDbFlag29Get(ClearDb* db, u32 missionId, u8 slotKind)

name: MissionClearBitSet
signature: void MissionClearBitSet(ClearDb* db, u32 missionId, bool on)
description: sets/clears bit0 of entry+0x24+slot in map +0x2C8 (used by SetMissionCleared 0x1C1DB88 and the NG reset 0x215A57C)

name: MissionClearDbByte15Set
signature: void MissionClearDbByte15Set(ClearDb* db, u32 missionId, u8 v)

name: MissionClearResetLateChapters
description: when mode==1 && journey==2 and missions 0x7B35 cleared: resets clear bit/byte15 of every record with +0x164==1 and +0x166>4000

name: ShrineItemVisible
description: shrine top-menu item visibility by mission flag: 0->0xA0, 1->0x9F, 2->0xAC, 3 (Battle Scroll)->0xAB, 4->0x8C..0x8F, 6->0xC5, 7->0xA1/0xA2/0x183/0x193, 8->0x212

name: ShrineItemEnabled
description: shrine item enable; item 3 offline = inventory count (0x505454) < 2000

name: ShrineTopMenu_Update
description: item 3: if !(FeatureUnlocked(8) && flag 0x217) -> MenuOpenMissionReplay else open BattleScroll top [g_MenuMgr+0x490]

name: BattleScrollTop_Select
description: option 0 -> MenuOpenMissionReplay(m,0,6) ([g_MenuMgr+0x4E0]); option 1 -> Emaki select [g_MenuMgr+0x4E8] via 0x1DC6810

name: MissionReplayMenu_Open
signature: void MissionReplayMenu_Open(Menu* replay, Menu* owner, u32 missionId, u8 mode)
description: fills an 0x88-B 0xFF param block and calls 0x1DC8424

name: MissionReplayMenu_Setup
signature: void MissionReplayMenu_Setup(Menu* m, Menu* owner, u32 a, void* params, u32 missionId, u8 journey, u8 b)
description: stores mission id (+0x24F4), journey (mode 6 -> current), era byte from record +0x160, then vtbl+0x380 (build)

name: ShrineMenu_OpenFromMission
signature: void ShrineMenu_OpenFromMission(Menu* m, u32 a, u32 missionId, u8 b)
description: sets +0x86 when FeatureUnlocked(8) and mission record flags40 & 0x1000000 (emaki-capable)

name: FeatureUnlocked
description: bitset at [0x4B6A170]+8; bit 8 gates the Picture Scroll (Emaki) half of Battle Scroll

name: Script_Mission_IsTrainingMission
description: returns current mission id ([[0x45B9E40]]+0x64) == 0x6F24 (Training Ground record)

name: g_DataMgr
description: [g]+0 = mission table bytes (hdr 8 + n*0x198), [g]+0x20 id->index map
